Show prints a friction entry in full: who filed it, where, and with which
build, its detail, attached command, votes, duplicates, and resolution.

Its links to the same problem on other hosts are checked over the bus and
listed with that entry's kind (in parentheses), status and votes there, e.g.
"#34@monolith1 (bug) open, +2 there: ...". A link that has gone stale is
flagged with "!" and what to run: out of step (one end closed, the other
open), one-sided (the other host has no link back), not found (no such
entry there, or a different one under its id), or unreachable (what was
last seen).

Usage:
  agent friction show <id> [flags]

Examples:
  agent friction show 12
  agent friction show 12 --json

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for show
      --json   Print as JSON

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
